2 نجّذهُ (assumed tropical:) It (experience) strengthened him:
(A:) or tried and strengthened him. (S, L.) Suheym Ibn-Wetheel says, “وَنَجَّذَنِى مُدَاوَرَةُ الشُّؤُونِ
” [And the applying myself to the management of affairs has tried and strengthened me]. (S, L.) See 3, in art. دور. And see نِجّد.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
